title: A Computer Program for Two-Beam Convergent Beam Electron Diffraction Pattern Simulation and Foil Thickness Measurement
content:
Abstract
We created a computer program, Simulation and Measurement with Accuracy of a Rocking curve for crystal Thickness (SMART), developed using OpenJDK, for TEM characterization in materials research and education. It is designed for simulating two-beam convergent beam electron diffraction (CBED) patterns and analyzing experimental two-beam CBED patterns to measure foil thickness. The combination of simulation and analysis extends its applicability in two ways: it enables the evaluation of relative foil thicknesses through comparison with simulated patterns, and it allows verification of analysis results by generating simulations using parameters obtained from the measured thicknesses.
